message:
Hey everyone! 🌟 We recently had a great chat in our family group about what to keep in an emergency kit. It’s one of those things that can feel overwhelming, but breaking it down together really helps. 

We found a solid resource that outlines what essentials to include, making it easier to get started. Having a well-stocked kit can bring peace of mind and a sense of readiness, no matter what life throws our way.

What’s one item you think is a must-have in your emergency kit? Let’s share our tips!
